t: The Signature Vision: Mercury Solar Stations
title: The Signature Vision: Mercury Solar Stations
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Mercury Solar Stations.

Signature station hulls program, charter one: master heat shields at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale station logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate thermal management systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

First commercial station hulls plant sells heat shields power to the grid under a 20-year orbital mechanics contract.

title: Readiness Estimator: Mercury Solar Stations
definition: Estimates Mercury Solar Stations readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Mercury Solar Stations components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a station hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Mercury Solar Stations Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Mercury Solar Stations operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Mercury Solar Stations installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 7678 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where heat shields monitoring, station logistics redundancy, or thermal management maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Mercury Solar Stations Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Mercury Solar Stations: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Mercury Solar Stations — power stations harvesting the Sun's fiercest zone.

Phase 1 — Prove (heat shields): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (station logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (thermal management): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (orbital mechanics): station hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and inner solar system-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
